items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: The other one was put into the book way back around 1953, '54 by Neal Hefti, where I play a clarinet lead on a tune

ctx.x: I said, 'With the regular (inaudible)?' and he said, 'No, no clarinet (inaudible).'

There's not a clarinet book in there. The only clarinet -- at the time that I left the band, there was three things in his book that had clarinet in it. One was -- the last one that was put in it was a thing called "Blues Inside Out," by Quincy Jones, which I played the clarinet on the record on one of the albums. The other one was put into the book way back around 1953, '54 by Neal Hefti, where I play a clarinet lead on a tune -- I can't think of the name of it right now. The other thing is eight bars on "April…
